items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher As Rate Hike Fears Ease
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Tuesday, Aug, 11 2026 US stock futures are slightly higher this morning, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.1% and tech heavy Nasdaq futures gaining around 0.4%. Softer U.S. jobs data is a key driver. July payrolls fell by 23,000, which reduces the chance of another interest rate hike and can ease pressure on mortgages, credit cards and auto loans.
